Ultra Open Earbuds feature a brilliant combination of innovative open-ear design, incredible audio, and all-day comfort. With a cuff-like fit, Ultra Open Earbuds leave your ears open to hear the world around you while OpenAudio technology delivers rich, private sound.

Experience the pinnacle of wireless listening with the Sony WF-1000XM6 noise cancelling earbuds. Designed for music lovers and professionals alike, these earbuds feature industry-leading noise cancellation powered by Sony's HD Noise Cancelling Processor QN3e, which is three times faster than previous generations. Whether you're surrounded by city hustle, commuting, or seeking focus at home, the adaptive noise cancelling technology keeps distractions away and amplifies your favorite tracks for pure, uninterrupted enjoyment. Co-created with mastering audio engineers, the Sony WF-1000XM6 earbuds deliver studio-level sound quality, capturing rich details and spaciousness in every song. The original custom drivers and advanced audio technology ensure balanced, precise sound no matter your playlist or environment. Multi Noise Sensor tech and Adaptive NC Optimizer constantly fine-tune the sound for an immersive listening experience tailored to your needs. With an ergonomic design and a secure fit, you can wear these earbuds comfortably throughout your day. The WF-1000XM6 offers up to 24 hours of battery life, IPX4 water resistance for active lifestyles, and multipoint connection so you can pair with multiple devices seamlessly. Enhance your experience with the Sound Connect App, enabling personalized control and updates. Elevate your calls with Sony's best-ever call quality, making every conversation crystal clear—even in noisy environments.

With the integrated camera, users can enjoy high-definition video quality during both day and night, featuring 4K video modes for clear visuals. The device offers two-way audio, allowing real-time communication, and motion-activated notifications, keeping users informed about any movement at their door. Furthermore, compatibility with the Ring app and integration with Alexa ensures seamless control and operation of this smart doorbell from anywhere, enhancing convenience and security for modern households.
